Steady Pace: a training brief

This brief describes a training program for runners returning after a layoff. It is written to be read once and acted on, so it stays short and it names the tradeoffs it is making.

The problem

Runners come back too fast. The first two weeks feel easy, the third week hurts, and the fourth week is spent injured on a couch reading about other people running.

The plan

  • Warm up for ten minutes
  • Warm up for ten minutes
  • Warm up for ten minutes
  • Run four easy miles on Tuesday
  • Rest completely on Wednesday

Send questions to the coach. The plan is a starting point, and it expects to be argued with by anyone who has run this distance before.
